SLOW COAL SMOKE: a slow coil of dark smoke rising off the coal bed, turning gently as it climbs toward the warm upper air
FLAT SMOKE LAYER: dark smoke hanging in one flat layer under the roof, the air below it golden and still
LEANING SMOKE THREAD: a thin thread of smoke leaning toward the nearest opening, curious and unhurried in the warm quiet
POOLING CORNER SMOKE: smoke pooling in the highest corner and staying there, soft and content in its warm little hollow
SOOT-BLUE WALL SMOKE: soot-blue smoke lying along a wall, tracing the gentle warmth of the stone behind it
LAZY RISING CURL: a lazy curl of dark smoke rising and thinning away into the warm amber air above
STEAM CLOUD OVER TROUGH: a soft white cloud of steam standing over the trough and thinning gently as it rises into the bright air
SLOW STEAM THREADS: steam lifting off wet stone in slow soft threads, each one curling up and fading into the warmth
LOW WARM STEAM: warm steam hanging low over still water, resting there like a pale and contented little cloud
STEAM VEIL AT FAR END: a gentle white veil of steam softening the far end of the hall into something almost dreamlike
BASE STEAM CLING: steam clinging around the base of the gear, soft and warm and perfectly at home in the glowing air
DRIFTING FINE ASH: fine grey ash drifting slowly down through the whole hall and settling in a pale soft layer on every ledge
FLOATING BRIGHT EMBERS: a few bright embers floating slowly upward, each one glowing cheerfully before going dark and cool
SETTLED SOFT ASH: ash lying soft on every flat surface, gentle and grey and dusted evenly across the whole warm space
GLOWING TURNING MOTES: glowing motes turning slowly in the warm air, each one tracing a lazy wandering path through the amber light
PALE ASH FALL: a slow fall of pale ash past the near edge, drifting down through the warm air with perfect unhurried grace
FURNACE MOUTH WOBBLE: the air over the furnace mouth wobbling so the far wall bends gently behind it, soft and dreamy
WARM ORANGE HAZE: a warm orange haze filling the hall and softening the far arches into something rich and inviting
THICK GLOWING FLOOR AIR: the air thick and glowing near the floor, warm and golden and full of a quiet amber radiance
HEAT WOBBLE ALONG HOT SURFACES: a heat wobble running along the top of everything hot, making the whole far end shimmer like a gentle daydream
SOFT DEPTH BANDS: warm haze layering the depth of the hall into soft glowing bands, each one a little hazier and more golden than the last
LOW COOL DRAUGHT: clear cool air coming in low from one side so the near air is sharp and bright and the far end stays warmly hazy
CRISP WASHED AIR: the air washed clean through the hall and every far detail standing out crisp and clear and full of colour
SMOKE-THINNING DRAUGHT: a cool draught thinning the smoke to nothing near the floor, leaving the low air clean and the upper air warm
COOL HEAT MEETING LINE: cold clear air meeting the heat in a soft line across the hall, one side sharp and the other side glowing
